sections.Profile:
Cyclone is the second game in Barry Oursler's amusement park trilogy, between Comet (1985) and Hurricane (1991). Set in a carnival midway, the playfield features a working Ferris wheel toy, Spook House, Shooting Gallery drop targets, and a spinning Mystery Wheel in the backbox.
